# Clearance

A greedy least-cost-path reblocker with one physical knob, `repulsion`. Each road is the least-cost path from the current deepest parcel to the existing road+street network on a grid whose edge costs repel from building points — the knob sweeps from aspirational straight roads to buildable roads that hug the maximum-clearance (Voronoi) gaps between homes. Roads are added until an access-depth target is met, so it spends the least road for the depth it buys.

Configuration: [`conf/method/clearance.yaml`](https://github.com/jmendoza167/REU_Slum_Optimization/blob/main/conf/method/clearance.yaml)

## Head-to-head on one deep block

From the [method-comparison example](https://github.com/jmendoza167/REU_Slum_Optimization/tree/main/examples/method-comparison): six reblockers on `ZAF.9.3.1_1_40972`, the deepest topology-tractable block in the Cape Town metro (263 parcels, up to 7 rings deep). Blue = added roads; building sites shade grey to red by displacement risk; the depth heatmap goes pale as roads reach every parcel.
